title: Reverse Linked List II
signature: reverseBetween(head: ListNode, left: int, right: int) -> ListNode
statement: Reverse the nodes from position left to position right (1-based, inclusive) and return the head of the list.
reference_solution:
def reverseBetween(head, left, right):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    for _ in range(left - 1):
        prev = prev.next
    cur = prev.next
    for _ in range(right - left):
        nxt = cur.next
        cur.next = nxt.next
        nxt.next = prev.next
        prev.next = nxt
    return dummy.next

hints.1_question: Walk to the node just before position left. Then you need to reverse a stretch of right - left + 1 nodes while staying connected on both sides.
hints.2_nudge: Use a dummy head so left = 1 is not special. Keep `prev` fixed; repeatedly take the node after cur and move it to the front of the reversed section (right after prev).
hints.3_big_hint: for _ in range(right - left): nxt = cur.next; cur.next = nxt.next; nxt.next = prev.next; prev.next = nxt.
